messages:
SRE Alert Bot: [ALERT] spike in MFA pushes for org-admins (12 users) in last 10m. Many distinct IPs but same UA fingerprint. https://ops.redwood/alerts/2412345678
Alex Kim: seeing impossible-travel-ish pattern — same UA hash across multiple remote CIDRs. Could be IP aliasing / mobile proxy clusters. Anyone able to pull auth logs?
Priya Shah: pulling from logs now. query: ```SELECT user, ip, ua_hash, ts FROM auth.events WHERE ts > now() - interval '1 hour' AND user LIKE 'admin%' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 200;```
Priya Shah: results: 12 users impacted, ~48 distinct IPs across 6 ASNs, ua_hash identical for ~10 events. High retry counts, many MFA push failures -> MFA fatigue risk.
Jamal Ortiz: recommended containment: (1) revoke active sessions for affected users, (2) throttle MFA pushes at the org-level, (3) block suspicious IP ranges/ASNs temporarily, (4) enable strict backoff on push retries.
Alex Kim: I'll run session revokes now. @Jamal can you assemble the IP/ASN blocklist? @Priya can you confirm audit logs/SSE-KMS status?
Priya Shah: audit logs are in S3 with SSE-KMS. KMS alias: alias/redwood-audit. Last rotation 2024-03-15. Immutable retention policy in place for 30d. Rotating now is possible but will schedule if needed.
sec_ops_bot: run: ```redwood sessions revoke --users $(cat affected_admins.txt) --force``` -> 200 OK, 12 sessions revoked. Summary: all web tokens invalidated, short notice to clients.
Jamal Ortiz: pushed blocks for ASN 39423 and ASN 20345 on perimeter + WAF rules. Also added temporary rate limit on /auth/push = 30 requests/min per account.
Alex Kim: notified Legal & SOC-Comm for possible customer impact. Also applied a temporary RBAC change: removed "org_admin:impersonate" from admin_role while we verify. Documented change in infra-changes.
Priya Shah: from the audit trail: no successful token exchange or suspicious API calls from those IPs — only push attempts and retries. No lateral movement observed.
Alex Kim: set post-incident owner: @Jamal. Next actions: 1) tune detection: alert on UA-hash reuse across >=3 ASNs in 15m, 2) implement MFA push cool-off/backoff, 3) review KMS key rotation playbook, 4) add RBAC emergency rollback runbook.
Jamal Ortiz: booked KMS rotation prep with infra Thu 03:00 UTC — pre-checks include decrypt test vectors and access policy audit. Will add new alert for UA-hash reuse.
Priya Shah: metrics returning to baseline after rate limits and revokes. WAF blocks remain for 4h, then we'll reassess. Filing incident report: https://docs.redwood/incidents/2412345678
Alex Kim: thanks all — great quick coordination. :thumbsup: I'll fill incident summary + action items in #postmortems and ping product + support for comms if needed.
